title: euodia sambucina
intro: Euodia sambucina, commonly known as Szechuan pepper tree or Chinese pepper, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to China and Southeast Asia. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and fever. The therapeutic actions of Euodia sambucina include stimulating digestion, relieving nausea and vomiting, and reducing pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonene, pinene, and sesquiterpenes, which may contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a valuable herb in traditional Chinese medicine.
